items: Berth planning static vs. yard reality; anchorage waits cost.
Ransomware exposure post-industry incidents; recovery untested.

blocks.x: The planning platform unified vessel/yard/tide data with scenario engines; crane telemetry drives predictive maintenance; a Quanta tournament on stowage formulations delivered 5% handling-time gains (industrialized); and IT/OT segmentation plus restore-tested recovery proved restart at 6 hours in drills.

The program ran through the Achala Method: a Value Mapping Sprint locked the baseline, a gated PoC produced the capital-grade evidence, and production hardening (replay, SLOs, control tests) was generated by the delivery itself rather than reconstructed for audit.
